rolls back and never updates it.

put.description:
Replace the whole priority list (the Save button). Codes that stay keep their `added_at`, so the
planner's order of the list does not change.

post.description: Ask ULDK what was pasted before any expensive work ("Czy to ta działka?"). Short and synchronous.

get.description: A member sees their own checks; an admin sees everyone's.

CheckSiteDetail.title: CheckSiteDetail
CheckSiteDetail.description: A scored parcel: what the site card shows, plus the verdict, the sheet and the manual next steps.

CoverageArea.title: CoverageArea
CoverageArea.description:
Kept sites of one administrative area (not excluded) and how many of them have data.

`with_data`, `total` and `share` follow the requested item: sites for a single item,
score items for `all`. `by_item` is always filled, so one response serves the table.

FactOut.title: FactOut
FactOut.description: A feature value with its provenance (brief section 4: source_id, as_of, confidence).

FailingPowiat.title: FailingPowiat
FailingPowiat.description: A powiat whose most recent search job failed, so its sites are going stale.

Grid60.title: Grid60
Grid60.description: Distances (km) at which the grid near a small plot can likely carry 60 MW. A proxy, not capacity.

planned_pse_load_station_km_bonus.title: Planned Pse Load Station Km Bonus

JobCounts.title: JobCounts
JobCounts.description: `pending` and `running` count every such job; `done` and `failed` only the last 24 hours.

ProfileVerdictOut.title: ProfileVerdictOut
ProfileVerdictOut.description: One investor profile's verdict: green / yellow / red, or manual when a missing answer decides it.

Proxies.title: Proxies
Proxies.description: Settings of the OSM proxies for penalties that have no public source (`sources/osm_infra.py`).

SiteMapOut.title: SiteMapOut
SiteMapOut.description: The site outline in metres (EPSG:2180, north up) around `origin_2180`, framed like a check sheet.

SiteSummary.title: SiteSummary
SiteSummary.description: One row of the ranked list. Scores are 0–100; `score` is what the list sorts on by default.

SmallSites.title: SmallSites
SmallSites.description: Small plots (up to 2 ha) where the grid, not the land, carries the 60 MW (PLAN.md).
